message: I at one time was receiving cigarette promotions from a tobacco company. I discontinued the promotions for awhile, but I would like to start again. I believe the company pertained to Doral. I now smoke Mustang Menthol Lights 100's and I enjoy them. I was wondering if your company has promotions for Mustang cigarettes - your $2.00 discount on a carton is great - but I wish they were more often. I have received promotions in the past for gifts or free cartons for saving stamps on top of the pack.
signature: Thank you, Robert E. Neeld Sr.
